name: len
statement: f(n) = length of a sequence; counts elements

name: sum
statement: f(xs) = sum of the elements of a list

name: factorial
statement: f(n) = n factorial, the product of 1..n

name: fibonacci
statement: f(n) = the n-th Fibonacci number

name: is_prime
statement: f(n) = True iff n is a prime number

name: gcd
statement: f(a, b) = greatest common divisor of a and b

name: abs
statement: f(n) = absolute value of n

name: max
statement: f(xs) = the maximum element of a list

name: min
statement: f(xs) = the minimum element of a list

name: reverse
statement: f(xs) = the list xs in reverse order

name: sorted
statement: f(xs) = the list xs sorted ascending

name: pow
statement: f(b, e) = b raised to the power e

name: mod
statement: f(a, b) = remainder of a divided by b

name: floor_div
statement: f(a, b) = floor of a divided by b

name: digits
statement: f(n) = list of decimal digits of n

name: count_true
statement: f(xs) = number of true elements in a boolean list

name: identity
statement: f(n) = n, the identity function

name: square
statement: f(n) = n squared

name: double
statement: f(n) = twice n

name: binary
statement: f(n) = binary string representation of n
